text:
jamie: Heads-up — while checking the onboarding runbook I noticed a few internal shortlinks redirecting to 404s. pinging @lisa and @devon who have touched this area recently. link: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/onboarding

devon: Ack. Which anchors/shortlinks?

jamie: The top nav TOC has two entries that jump to /kb/quickstart#env-setup and /kb/quickstart#secrets but both 404 in staging. Also an old shortlink /r/run-onboard -> 301 -> 404.

lisa: Thanks for the heads-up. I think /r/run-onboard was deprecated during the slug change. I can claim ownership for the quickstart page if nobody objects. :raised_hands:

pat: Quick question — are these busted in prod or only staging? I saw similar earlier from the preview environment.

jamie: Only staging right now but the shortlink 301 is visible in prod logs (low volume) so worth fixing. docs-bot: scan detected 3 dead anchors in /runbooks/onboarding during nightly link-sweep.

devon: If lisa takes ownership I can throw up a tiny PR to replace the shortlink and fix anchors. sed snippet for anyone wanting to run locally: 

```
rg "\b/r/run-onboard\b" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i '' 's|/r/run-onboard|/runbooks/onboarding|g' {}
rg "#env-setup" -n || true
```

lisa: Sounds good. jamie — can you paste the two exact anchor names that 404ed? I'll add canonical anchors to the quickstart and leave a shortlink redirect for 6 months.

jamie: here you go: env-setup-2 and secrets-v2 (looks like a versioned anchor collision).

devon: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pulls/842 — small change, updates anchors + adds redirect for /r/run-onboard. CI shows a docs lint warning about missing frontmatter owner on that page.

lisa: I'll add myself in frontmatter owner field in that PR, and add a one-line changelog entry. Thanks devon for the PR.

pat: I'll run the staging preview once it's up and sanity-check anchors. If staging preview shows green, ok to merge. :+1:

docs-bot: automated check — change includes redirect entry, anchor updates, and frontmatter owner added. No link regressions detected in preview build 6137779150.

jamie: Nice, thanks everyone. devon — when you merge can you also tag the PR with "owner:lisa" so the docs rotation automation picks it up?

devon: yep -- merging after pat confirms preview. will add tag before merge.

lisa: thanks all. filing a quick follow-up task to audit other /r/ shortlinks later this week.

pat: preview looks good to me, merge away.

devon: merged and tagged owner:lisa — closing thread. :tada:
